verdict.rationale: ROS 2 documents public programmatic interfaces. Official client libraries in multiple languages, including an idiomatic Python API, expose the core functionality (topics, services, actions, parameters). The `ros2` CLI lets you publish, echo and introspect the graph from scripts. Missing for 10: feature parity across client libraries (inter/intra-process, composition, lifecycle and content filtering are C++-only), and independent hands-on evidence of agents driving ROS 2 through these APIs.
